title: ‘Zionists Are the Enemies of the Jews’: Jewish Author of Provocative New Book on Anti-Zionism
author: Mehdi Hasan
content:
Some of the earliest people to reject Zionism weren't Palestinian; they were
Jewish. That history, which rarely comes up in modern discussion around
Israel's occupation of Palestine, is the central topic of the latest book from
Pulitzer Prize-winning author **Benjamin Moser**.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

 _' ANTI-ZIONISM: A Jewish History'_ spotlights some of history's most
renowned Jewish thinkers, authors, poets, and many more who rejected Zionism.
**" The whole point of this book is to say that Jews and Zionists are not the
same thing; they've never been the same thing,"** Moser tells **Mehdi**.

Mehdi took the role of devil's advocate to push Moser on some of the criticism
his book has received. This important and sensitive conversation also covered:

  * Why even Jewish rabbis believed that **" Zionists are the enemies of the Jews"**

  * How Moser justifies his denial of Israel's right to exist

  * Why he views cultural and liberal Zionism as a **" fantasy of Zionism"**

  * Historical Jews who were attacked, and even killed, for their opposition to Zionism

  * What a future state on the historical land of Palestine should look like.
